prompt: Watercolor painting, close-up scene of a dynamic and romantic pair of Red-crowned Cranes perched on a gracefully bending pine tree branch over a softly flowing river. One crane stands mid-step, lifting one slender leg gracefully while gently balancing on the branch, wings slightly open for poise and lightness. The second crane lovingly extends its long neck toward the stepping crane, their vivid red crowns nearly touching, expressing deep affection and connection. Their white and black-feathered bodies are rendered with loose, fluid watercolor brushstrokes, full of lightness and movement. Beneath them, the flowing river shimmers in soft blues, greens, and golden highlights, with smooth natural stones scattered along the current. The ancient pine tree stretches with rugged texture and lush needles, softly painted in translucent layers. Golden morning sunlight pours through the branches, creating a luminous, uplifting atmosphere. Mood: lively, tender, romantic, full of vitality and serenity. Color palette: misty greens, deep and pale blues, soft earth tones, brilliant whites, rich blacks, and vivid reds. Painting style: flowing, dynamic, impressionistic watercolor on textured paper, romantic realism. Ultra-high definition, painterly, elegant.
